# Commit and Push Prompt

- Stage only relevant changes for the update.
- Commit all staged changes to the current active branch (do not use a hardcoded branch name).
- Push the commit to the origin remote for the current active branch.
- Do not change branches or remotes.
- Use a clear, descriptive commit message summarizing the changes.
- Confirm the push was successful.
